talk.jaymoskingdoms.twinblade.amazed.1: Is that a Twinblade? On you? I never thought I'd see one outside a story.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.twinblade.amazed.2: Hold still. Let me look at that joining. Warrior-born work, no doubt of it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.twinblade.amazed.3: Thirty years at the anvil and I've never made one. Never even seen one. Where did you get it?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.twinblade.origin.1: My master's master spoke of these. It's a Warrior-born design, older than any kingdom: two blades made to be one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.twinblade.origin.2: The joining was an oath, they say. Two who fought as one. Few outside the Warrior-born ever held one, and fewer knew how it was put together.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.twinblade.origin.3: The last drawing of it is said to lie with the dead in the Stormborn Tomb. If you have one, someone went down there. Take care of it.
